category_title: Second-grade Hispanic students who rely on graphophonic cues but struggle with semantic monitoring
scenario_title: Reading aloud and miscuing on meaning-changing words
minimal_context: The student is reading the book Amelia Bedelia and the Baby aloud during a one-on-one tutoring session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start reading this book, Amelia Bedelia and the Baby.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay. I want to read it, but I don't think I know enough words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best. Go ahead and read the sentence on this page.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What is the last word in that sentence?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the picture) ...bowls. Babies should have bowls.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's start reading this book, Amelia Bedelia and the Baby.

STUDENT: Okay. I want to read it, but I don't think I know enough words.

TUTOR: Just try your best. Go ahead and read the sentence on this page.

STUDENT: Babies should have...

TUTOR: What is the last word in that sentence?

STUDENT: (Looks at the picture) ...bowls. Babies should have bowls.

task.content: Reading the book Amelia Bedelia and the Baby for the first time and discussing specific miscues during a Retrospective Miscue Analysis (RMA) session
task.learning_goal: Ensure they are reading for meaning and facilitates student thinking

context.materials: The book Amelia Bedelia and the Baby, audio record of the reader's oral reading
context.time_context: During the first visit and subsequent RMA sessions

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When conferring with Sofia about her miscues and encountering words where she relied on picture clues
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: She read 'Babies should have bowls' for Babies shouldn't have bottles. She miscued 'bowls' for bottles. She predicted the meaning of bottles from the picture, though she sounded it out as 'bowls.'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Believed that she did not know enough words

behavior_patterns.condition: When encountering words with specific endings or contractions
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Left out some word endings (e.g., read flowered as 'flower') and miscued many times on couldn't and shouldn't (e.g., read 'should' instead of shouldn't), which changed the meaning of the text
